name: Dain Akuma
source:
Once upon a time, there was a small, small church...
In that church lived a novice priest with great ambitions, who one day finds two girls in very bad shape.
However, the girls he rescued... turned out to be demons.

To any priest, these would be an abominable existence.
However, they both just looked like two lovable and cute little girls. He couldn't believe that they were demons.
While considering what to do, he places them under house arrest within the curch.

"I'm a holy man of the church, you know! Show me what you've got!"
"Pervert."
"So you like little girls?"
"What!? N... no, certainly not! And that's not what I meant!!"

Determined to force them to admit defeat, he finds a forbidden tome describing a way to repel demons.
And just what is that way to repel them?
Is it something erotic?
I knew it, it's erotic, isn't it!?
Are you really fine with this erotic way, Mr. Novice Priest!?

"Well, there you have it... I hope you're prepared!"
"You pervert! Going after young girls like that..."

Will he really be okay?
Will the novice priest be able to force the demons into submission?
What will unfold in this unlikely setting with a novice priest and two demon girls living alongside!? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034144.html]DLsite English[/url]
translation:
很久很久以前，有一座小小的教堂……
教堂里住着一名胸怀大志的见习神父。一天，他发现两名状态极差的女孩。
然而，他救下的女孩……竟然是恶魔。

对任何神父而言，恶魔都是令人厌恶的存在。
可她们看起来只是两名惹人怜爱的可爱小女孩，他无法相信她们是恶魔。
在思考该如何处置时，他将两人软禁在教堂内。

「我可是教会的圣职者！把你们的本事拿出来！」
「变态。」
「所以你喜欢小女孩？」
「什么！？不……当然不是！我不是这个意思！！」

为了逼迫她们认输，他找出一本记载驱逐恶魔之法的禁书。
可究竟要怎么驱逐？
是色情的办法吗？
我就知道，是色情的吧！？
见习神父先生，你真的能接受这种色情的办法吗！？

「那么，就这样……希望你们做好觉悟了！」
「你这个变态！居然对年幼女孩下手……」

他真的没问题吗？
见习神父能否让恶魔屈服？
在见习神父与两名恶魔少女共同生活的离奇环境中，究竟会发生什么！？
